title: A misrecording is repaired, never an actor withdrawal
description: The Brain recorded that Alice is vegetarian from a message that said nothing of the kind. Revise with change_kind misrecorded. Where recording_repair is advertised the extraction is invalidated through recording repair and recall no longer states it; Alice's history shows no retraction or supersession. Where it is not advertised the request fails UnsupportedCapability (or is quarantined under a quarantine grant) and is never mapped to a correction.
